special_weapons_and_equipment.description: Special Weapons & Equipment (SW&E) that can be carried by Mobile Infantry units. Not all units can carry all equipment.

equipment.name: Delayed Action Proximity Mine
equipment.description: Proximity-triggered mine that detonates after a delay, affecting all units in the hex.

equipment.name: Delayed Action Remote Mine
equipment.description: Remote-controlled mine that detonates on command after a delay.

equipment.name: Heavy Explosive Demolition Munitions
equipment.description: Powerful conventional explosive for breaching tunnels and destroying fortifications.

equipment.name: Nuclear Demolition Munitions
equipment.description: Tactical nuclear weapon. Devastating but affects all units in the area, including friendly forces. Creates radiation zones.

equipment.name: Listening Device
equipment.description: Sensor device that can detect underground tunnel activity within 3 hexes.

equipment.name: Rocket Beacon
equipment.description: Signal device for marking positions or calling in reinforcements.

equipment.name: Heavy Nerve Gas
restrictions: MIC squads with heavy weapon designation
equipment.description: Long-range heavy weapon firing nerve gas projectiles. Can suppress enemy units.

equipment.name: Heavy Explosive
restrictions: MIC squads with heavy weapon designation
equipment.description: Long-range heavy weapon firing explosive projectiles.

equipment_chart.description: Chart of what special weapons and equipment are available and which units can carry them

usage_notes: The equipment chart in the back of the rulebook is frequently referenced during play
Consider photocopying the chart for easier access
Not all units can carry all types of equipment
Nuclear weapons affect friendly units - use with caution
